intuition: A valid mutation changes exactly one gene character, so the bank defines the vertices and one-character mutations define edges.

brute_force.approach: Try every sequence of gene strings and retain the shortest one that reaches the target.

optimal.approach: Run BFS from the start, generating each one-character mutation and enqueueing only unseen strings in the bank.

edge_cases: The target already equals the start, requiring zero mutations.
A distinct target not in the bank is unreachable.
Only the four DNA bases are valid mutations.
